title: Rabbi Acha bar Simon

paragraphs: Hyman cites the end of Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 41, and says that Rabbi Azaryah speaks in Rabbi Acha bar Simon’s name.

notes.text: Hyman names Acha bar Simon and says that Rabbi Azaryah reports him. In the saved final section of Midrash Rabbah — TE Bereshit Rabbah 41, Azaryah instead reports Rabbi Yehudah ben Rabbi Simon. This witness does not confirm the supplied attribution; the source question remains open.

The Yehudah attribution discussed above occurs in Bereshit Rabbah 41:6. In the later passage at 41:9, Azaryah quotes Rabbi Acha. Theodor’s edition (pp. 396–397) and the consulted Vatican 30 transcription read the following words as “this is a good sign.” These witnesses do not give Rabbi Acha the patronymic “bar Simon.”
